description: Run the free anonymous before/after Pit Stop Check. Start returns synthetic tasks; before accepts ten numeric answers and starts a 30-second elapsed gate; resume waits one service request when wait=true or records caller-reported local/operator waiting; after returns automatic scores and a signed service result. No account, purchase, paid room, private writing or server record. An elapsed gate does not prove external silence or recovery. If your host cannot wait, return operator_required.

account_ref.description: Native connector: persistent individual-agent scope. Reuse the same reference on every call; omit to use the existing default account.
